articles.title: Bitcoin, ether little-changed despite record stocks, falling oil and easing war fears
articles.snippet: Global stocks hit records and oil cracked on a tentative US-Iran ceasefire extension. Crypto stayed on the sidelines, with some analysts saying the next catalyst is regulatory, not geopolitical.

articles.title: Ethereum analysts say ‘downside pressure’ remains as $1.8K becomes key
articles.snippet: Analysts warn Ether’s downside risks remain elevated as traders closely watch the $1,800 support zone for stability.

articles.title: Fidelity Digital Assets highlights 'growing evidence' of shift from dollar-based systems
articles.snippet: The investment firm said nation-states and central banks are increasingly turning to assets like Bitcoin and gold as alternative settlement systems outside of US control.

articles.title: AI Chatbots Could Quietly Pull Users Away From Reality, Researchers Warn
articles.snippet: Researchers warn that prolonged chatbot interactions could distort how some users experience reality and social connection.

articles.title: Here's How Much Bitcoin Elon Musk Would Control If SpaceX and Tesla Merge
articles.snippet: If Tesla and SpaceX merged—as is a reported possibility—then Elon Musk's combined entity would hold billions of dollars' worth of Bitcoin.
